memory_candidates.content: On the deadline-ladder run layer (RaySummary/RunLayer.lean), realized cells at a ladder state (q, c, n) depend on BOTH counters: Count hands a region starting at the next step the length n, so any stabilization lemma must quantify over the pair (c, n), not c alone.

A fresh .olean tree (no FormalSystem source newer than FormalSystem.olean, no guard holder) lets a Section-0 compile record be produced by one foreground `lake env lean` on a scratch file importing FormalSystem with #check/#print axioms lines, instead of a detached lake build.
